name: clipboard-mcp-server
description: Read, write, and inspect the system clipboard across macOS, Linux (X11/Wayland), and Windows via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

MCP_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log Level
MCP_LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum log level for output. Options: debug, info, notice, warning, error.

CLIPBOARD_READ_ONLY.title: Read-Only Mode
CLIPBOARD_READ_ONLY.description: Serve the clipboard read-only. When true, the clipboard_write tool is not registered. Accepts true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off.
